title: Lean LFM-to-Dirac Derivation
description: Noncanonical Lean 4 research derivation through DIRAC-010. Starting from a positive two-field C19 action, the artifact derives a cubical continuum square root with an explicit lattice remainder and maps both native rank-four copies to the conventional Dirac alpha/beta representation. Physical mass, the full continuum Dirac equation, spin and an electron remain open.
